about: Where every file in brand/ came from, with its SHA-256. build.py refreshes the hashes.

README.md.source: Written for this brand home on 2026-09-28: the usage sheet. Its section order follows the shared Sylphx brand-kit brief.

brand.json.source: Written for this brand home on 2026-09-28: which master feeds which generated file, and which surface file is a copy of which brand file.

og/anymd-og-vector.svg.source: docs/public/og-image.svg: added in 1372688 (2026-07-01, #340), redrawn in a06881d (2026-09-22, #726) and 4d7adfd (2026-09-25, #741). The earlier all-vector card; still served at /anymd/og-image.svg, linked by nothing.

og/anymd-og.html.source: bench/demo/og-image.html: added in 435437f (2026-09-25, #754). The logo it inlines as a data URI was refreshed to the current app-icon master in this change.

og/anymd-og.png.source: Rendered from brand/og/anymd-og.html, a browser screenshot of that page at 1280x640. Served at docs/public/og-image.png since 435437f (2026-09-25, #754).

svg/anymd-app-icon-square.svg.source: Derived in this change from brand/svg/anymd-app-icon.svg: the same artwork on a full-bleed tile with no corner radius, so iOS can apply its own mask to apple-touch-icon.

svg/anymd-app-icon.svg.source: docs/public/logo.svg: added in 426bb5c (2025-04-06), redrawn in a06881d (2026-09-22, #726), redrawn for the anymd name in 4d7adfd (2026-09-25, #741); moved into brand/ in this change with the "Citra mark" comment corrected.

svg/anymd-maskable.svg.source: Derived in this change from brand/svg/anymd-app-icon.svg: the same artwork on a full-bleed tile, the mark scaled to 0.7 about the centre so the document and the citation pip stay inside the 40% safe circle of any launcher mask.

svg/anymd-symbol-black.svg.source: Derived in this change from brand/svg/anymd-symbol.svg: one colour, the evidence lines cut out as holes because in the colour files they are the ground colour showing through.

svg/anymd-symbol-white.svg.source: Derived in this change from brand/svg/anymd-symbol.svg: one colour, the evidence lines cut out as holes because in the colour files they are the ground colour showing through.

svg/anymd-symbol.svg.source: Derived in this change from brand/svg/anymd-app-icon.svg: the document alone (page, folded corner, evidence lines) on a tight viewBox. The citrus tile and the citation pip are not part of the symbol.

tokens.json.source: The colours of docs/.vitepress/theme/custom.css ("citrus lab", added in ed1d152 2025-12-17) and of the app-icon master, written out on 2026-09-28.
